parties: BCP Asia II Holdco VII Pte. Ltd. (acquirer); Aadhar Housing Finance Limited (target)
headline: BCP Asia II Holdco VII triggers SEBI Reg 31(4) disclosure in Aadhar Housing Finance
sum: Singapore-based BCP Asia II Holdco VII has filed a mandatory SEBI Takeover Code disclosure crossing the 25% threshold in Aadhar Housing Finance Limited, signalling an advanced-stage substantial acquisition in a systemically regulated housing finance company and triggering open offer or exemption petition obligations.
implication: Housing finance acquisitions above 25% trigger mandatory SEBI takeover disclosure under Reg 31(4); the acquirer must now either proceed to public open offer or seek exemption from SEBI, with HFCs subject to dual NHB + SEBI regulatory scrutiny.
detail: BCP Asia II Holdco VII Pte. Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled private equity vehicle, has filed a formal substantial acquisition disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing indicates the acquisition has reached an advanced stage and is conditional on satisfaction of all conditions precedent. Aadhar Housing Finance Limited is a registered and systemically important housing finance company. The 25% threshold trigger mandates either a public open offer to remaining shareholders or an exemption petition to SEBI.
